title: Evidence chunks, hybrid retrieval and citation-checked conclusions
scenario: MFH auditors want 'approved before deploy' cited to the page, table cell or deploy-log row so the external auditor can re-perform it. Evidence sits in a (fake) Azure Blob container as Document Intelligence layout JSON and CSV. Chunk it with locators, retrieve with BM25 plus vectors fused by RRF, ask a fake Gemini for a cited JSON claim, and accept it only if every citation checks out.
task: Chunk layout JSON and CSV with resolvable locators; split tables by row with headers repeated
Implement BM25, hashing-vector cosine and reciprocal rank fusion
Write a fail-closed citation verifier that recomputes the conclusion from cited timestamps
Expand paragraph hits to their page and send the evidence as data to the model
acceptance: Locators, chunk ids and table/CSV rows exactly as specified
Retrieval scores and RRF ordering match hand-computed values
Fabricated quotes, wrong pages, wrong cells and mere mentions end as insufficient_evidence
Paragraph and table-cell citations verify; conclusions contradicting timestamps are rejected

practices.label: Week 5 Mon - document parsing that keeps page numbers
Week 5 Tue - chunking and hybrid search
Week 5 Wed - citations and insufficient evidence
